title: Bowler Matchups: When Should Chennai Super Kings Break Its Preferred Rotation?
dek: When should Chennai Super Kings break their preferred bowling rotation to target a batter? Bowling-type and batting-hand match-ups since 2022 show where the edges are.
excerpt: League-wide since 2022, spin has been more expensive against left-handers than right-handers. Chennai Super Kings' own match-up profile shows whether they follow the pattern.

sections.heading: Rotations and Match-Ups
body: Most captains bowl their attack in a familiar order. The match-up school says the order should bend to the batters at the crease: an off-spinner to a left-hander, a left-arm seamer to a right-hander, and so on.

CricField matched each delivery's bowling type and batting hand from player-bio data. Since 2022 Chennai Super Kings' spinners have conceded {{ev:mu-team-spin-left}} an over to left-handers and {{ev:mu-team-spin-right}} to right-handers.

sections.heading: Where the Edges Are
body: For the rest of the league the comparable spin figures are {{ev:mu-rest-spin-left}} against left-handers and {{ev:mu-rest-spin-right}} against right-handers. Chennai Super Kings' pace attack conceded {{ev:mu-team-pace-left}} to left-handers and {{ev:mu-team-pace-right}} to right-handers.
The higher cost of Chennai Super Kings' spin against left-handers is the most direct signal for when to change the rotation.

sections.heading: When to Break the Plan
body: A match-up is worth breaking the rotation for when the gap is large and the sample behind it is solid. Small gaps in small samples are noise, and chasing them can leave the best bowlers with overs in the wrong phase.
For CSK, the practical rule is to bend the order only for the strongest match-ups and keep the phase plan otherwise.

sections.heading: Handedness Is Only One Dimension
body: A batter's hand is a crude stand-in for his strengths. Within each hand there are batters who sweep well and batters who cannot, which a type-by-hand table cannot see.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Bend the Rotation, Do Not Break the Phases
body: Chennai Super Kings should use match-ups to choose between bowlers of similar quality in the same phase, not to move overs between phases.
Individual batter-against-bowler-type records, shrunk for small samples, are the next level of detail.
